mechanism_narrative: A sustained 5-month increase in GDP growth (GDPC1) above its 3-year rolling average signals accelerating demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations rise.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth slows below its 3-year average for 2 consecutive quarters, the signal should reverse, and S&P 500 returns should not exceed baseline levels (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below its 6-month moving average signals weakening manufacturing output, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as profit margins compress.
failure_condition: If INDPRO rebounds above its 6-month average for 2 consecutive months, the signal should reverse, and S&P 500 returns should not be significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% signals tighter monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as higher borrowing costs reduce corporate profitability.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS remains below 4.5% for 3 consecutive months, the signal should not activate, and S&P 500 returns should not be significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% signals labor market weakness, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending declines and corporate earnings expectations weaken.
failure_condition: If UNRATE remains below 4.0% for 3 consecutive months, the signal should not activate, and S&P 500 returns should not be significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above its 6-month moving average signals rising consumer demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations improve.
failure_condition: If RSAFS growth slows below its 6-month average for 2 consecutive months, the signal should reverse, and S&P 500 returns should not exceed baseline levels (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in the housing starts index (HOUST) below its 6-month moving average signals weakening residential construction activity, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as related sectors underperform.
failure_condition: If HOUST rebounds above its 6-month average for 2 consecutive months, the signal should reverse, and S&P 500 returns should not be significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% signals rising inflation, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the Federal Reserve tightens policy to combat inflation.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL remains below 3.0% for 3 consecutive months, the signal should not activate, and S&P 500 returns should not be significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the employment-population ratio (PAYEMS) above its 12-month moving average signals labor market strength, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and corporate earnings expectations improve.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS growth slows below its 12-month average for 2 consecutive months, the signal should reverse, and S&P 500 returns should not exceed baseline levels (t-test p > 0.05).
